warn_fcst.label: with a weather forecast; backtest uses observed weather as the forecast, so it is an upper bound

rule_hand.rule: alert when fc_err_max_24h/0.1 + wd*demand_vs_30d_peak + wt*|temp_anom_30d|/10 >= threshold

rule_record.rule: alert when the day-ahead forecast peak of the next 12 h / the BA's past record for this month >= threshold
